# Daily Dashboard V0.5.4

The weather widget's Apple Weather inspired visual style now extends across the dashboard: indigo backgrounds, translucent rounded cards, lighter typography, pale blue selections and rounded controls.

- Music, analog/digital clock, agenda, aircraft, command line and the optional Codex widget now share the same surfaces and control styling.
- Settings, navigation, timezone popovers, reminders, layout controls, idle-screen controls and empty states use the shared theme.
- Music retains both album-art modes and has a clear placeholder when artwork is unavailable. Terminal output remains monospace and aircraft altitude colours retain their meaning.
- The optional Codex activity area scrolls independently so the header and composer stay accessible in short widgets.
- Calendar Work mode, fitted working hours and event subcolumns remain intact.

## Verification

Production build, frontend unit checks and Rust tests are verified. The browser suite covers six enabled widgets at all four documented sizes across 19 resolution/scaling configurations (456 base cases), plus Settings, keyboard, clock, map and short-viewport interactions. The optional Codex widget is checked separately with its feature flag enabled.

Close Daily Dashboard before running the Windows installer over your existing version. The application identity and settings location remain unchanged. The physical Windows upgrade test remains to be performed on your machine.
